title: Neko Health raises $700 million to expand AI body scans in the US
slides: Can Neko Health’s scan find what your doctor missed?
It uses AI to detect early disease signs in minutes.
But competitor scans often miss these same signals.
Your next checkup might finally catch hidden risks.
Book a scan before insurers limit access to it.
thread_text:
1. Your doctor might miss it.

Neko Health’s AI scan detected early disease in minutes, while standard checkups had already overlooked the same symptoms.

2. Competitors are flying blind.

Rival full-body scans also promise early detection, yet they routinely miss signals that Neko’s AI catches.

3. The window is closing.

Health insurers are already moving to limit access—once they cap coverage, this option may vanish for most people.

4. What your next checkup won’t show.

Without AI, routine exams will keep hiding the risks that could be found now with a single scan.

5. Book your scan this week.

Check Neko Health’s availability in your city and schedule before insurers restrict access—don’t wait until it’s too late.
